name: Italian Lentil Bolognese
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) brown lentils, cooked (about 1½ cups)
150 g mushrooms and 1 carrot, finely chopped
1½ cups tomato passata and 1 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp each dried oregano and basil
Black pepper, salt and basil leaves
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and mushrooms for 8 minutes until the mushrooms brown.
Add the garlic and herbs, then the tomato paste, passata and lentils. Simmer for 20 minutes, adding water if it thickens too much.
Cook the spaghetti for 1 minute less than the pack says; add the zucchini for the last 30 seconds. Drain.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper.
Toss with the spaghetti and zucchini and top with basil.
note: Half the pasta is replaced by zucchini noodles, which lowers carbohydrate; lentils give a meaty texture.
